the regulation of mu opioid receptors in neuroblastoma cell lines and in primary neuronal cultures.
the mechanisms of action of retinoic acid on mu opioid receptors and c-fos expression in SH-SY 5Y neuroblastomas.
the mechanisms by which retinoids regulate the expression of opioid receptors and c-fos during neuronal differentiation.
